app.name: Keel
app.tagline: Program management where the conversation is the plan.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.askHint: Ask Keel arrives in phase 5. For now: navigation, programs, theme.

briefing.title: Briefing
briefing.body: Your start-of-day view: proposals waiting for approval, what changed since you last looked, program health, and check-ins.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: Split grid + Gantt with dependencies, critical path, baseline ghost bars and stage gates.

boards.title: Boards & tables
boards.body: Kanban and table views, sprint boards, backlog, burndown, workload heatmap and the budget view.

channels.title: Channels
channels.body: Program and workstream chat, Slack/Teams bridges, and "Promote to item".

mail.title: Mail triage
mail.body: Your synced mailbox with filing suggestions. Emails stay private until you file and share them.

report.title: Status report
report.body: An auto-drafted weekly report where every line links to its source.

raid.title: RAID log
raid.body: Risks, assumptions, issues and decisions, with a risk heat map.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Calendar, check-in cadence, members, connectors, AI (bring your own key) and import/export.

item.title: Item
item.body: Item detail with fields, relations and the unified stream of messages, email and events.
